question_text: Construct Shop.sell(self, item) in Python. item has public name and stock. self.request_units() returns the positive requested quantity. Subtract that quantity from item.stock, clamp negative stock to 0, and print name plus "sold out" if stock is 0; otherwise print name, requested quantity and remaining stock.
adaptation_rationale: Retains object-reference mutation, helper call and boundary/output branch es; new stock-management context with Python.

marking_points.criterion: Calls self.request_units exactly once and subtracts its result from item.stock.
Prints name and sold-out message when remaining stock is 0.
Otherwise prints name, requested quantity and remaining stock.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: Executable checks saved under checks/ where applicable.
